g.text: 9,556 all segmented tissue patches; illustrative coefficients; no clinical B/NB assignment
Area denominator: unique patch-covered area; overlap counted once. White: uncovered. Gray: not significant / not estimable.
Directions are relative to C15. These are regional interaction associations, not local B/NB labels or verified treatment effects.

g.text: Coefficients and uncertainty are artificially specified for visualization only. TCGA cluster identities do not match the paper model.
